title: Four's Additions
description: The mod adds multiple different things. From trees, to items from other games!
body:
Adds stuff that I think of when I want.  

Current list of things:  
-Pumpkin Soup  
-Carrot Soup  
-Bladewood Petal (made with Cherry leaves and upgrading them with netherite)  
-Bladewood Sword  
-Dreamer's Tulip (It's a flower)  
-Dreamer's Lotus (Gives you Night vision and glow effect. Can also be placed in water)  
-Dreamer's Essence (Crafted with Dreamer's Tulip(  
-Pink Candy (Makes you explode)  
-Yellow Candy (Makes you faster)  
-Blue Candy (Gives you absorption)  
-Steak in the Shape of Mettaton's Face (Cook a Steak)  
-Sweet Berry Jam  
-Glow Berry Jam  
-Sweet Berry Pie  
-Pumpkin Cookie  
-Hammers (Functions similar to axes. A bit faster/stronger)  
-Nails/Railway Spikes (Work like faster swords)  
-Amethyst Bricks (Normal/Cracked/Chiseled)  
-"Lotus" Items (Fences, "Floors", Door, Trapdoor and Music Disc)  
-Dimension "Lotus Waters"  
-Lotus Waters Ruined Portals  
-Blackwood Trees (Can be found in savannas and Wooded Badlands.)  
-Tamarack Trees and Biome  
-Yellowwood Trees (Can be found in forests)  
-Pistachio Trees (can rarely be found in forests or Halloween forests)  
-Peach Trees (Can rarely be found in Cherry Groves)  
-Almond Trees (Can rarely be found in Savannas)  
-Most items from "[Syrup 2: Candy Alchemy RPG](https://nomnomnami.itch.io/syrup-2)"  
-A Stop sign weapon.  

Lotus Waters Dimension:  
Build a portal (Like a nether portal) out of Cherry Wood. And then ignite it with the Dreamer's Essence Item.  

Some of the sprites are modified/versions of "[Syrup 2: Candy Alchemy RPG](https://nomnomnami.itch.io/syrup-2)". Please go and support the game, it makes up a big amount of the mod.
